Metric Definitions & Calculations

Productivity Metrics

Sales per Hour ($/Hr)
Total weekly store sales ($) / Total ambassador hours worked that week at that store.
Sephora Productivity %
From Sephora's monthly report. Measures brand sell-through as a % of the benchmark for that store's bay count.
100% Target
Dollar amount needed to achieve 100% productivity. Benchmark per bay x number of bays.
Gap to 50% / 70% / 100%
Dollar shortfall from target tier. Negative = above target.

Labor & ROI Metrics

Labor Cost
Total invoiced amount from Randstad. Includes wages + agency markup.
ROI (x)
Weekly Sales / Weekly Labor Cost. Target: >3.0x.

Coverage Metrics

Total Doors
All Sephora doors (788 total from Sephora directory).
Staffed Doors
Doors with Randstad ambassador coverage (67 current).
Sell-Through Coverage %
Sales from staffed doors / Total sales from all doors in data.

Store Attributes

Store Volume
Sephora volume: A++ (highest) through E (lowest).
Tier
Simplified: A = (A++, A+, A), B = B, C = (C, D, E).
Territory
Lawless regions: East, Central, West.
